$comment: Names, usage notes and type styles only. Colour, radius and shadow VALUES are generated from the app stylesheet by .design-sync/build.mjs; the themes list is set there too.

tokens.name: md-primary
tokens.usage: Link colour, the `.btn-filled` fill, the `.btn-outlined` and `.btn-text` label, `.section-head`, and the focused `.tf-outlined .field` border.

tokens.name: md-on-primary
tokens.usage: The label on an `md-primary` fill — `.btn-filled`, and the ready state of the pull-to-refresh circle.

tokens.name: md-primary-container
tokens.usage: `.fab`, `.fab-ext`, and the login screen's logo mark.

tokens.name: md-on-primary-container
tokens.usage: The glyph on an `md-primary-container` fill — `.fab`, `.fab-ext`, the login logo mark.

tokens.name: md-secondary
tokens.usage: The Material secondary ramp, kept so the palette is complete. No rule in the carried sheet reads it.

tokens.name: md-on-secondary
tokens.usage: The ink for `md-secondary`, kept so the palette is complete. No rule in the carried sheet reads it.

tokens.name: md-secondary-container
tokens.usage: `.btn-tonal`, `.chip.selected`, the active navbar pill, `.seg .seg-item.on`, and tonal list leading icons.

tokens.name: md-on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: The label on an `md-secondary-container` fill — `.btn-tonal`, the selected chip, the active navbar pill.

tokens.name: md-tertiary
tokens.usage: The switch and access-point device glyphs (`.ico-sw`, `.ico-ap`) on a 20% tint of the same hue.

tokens.name: md-on-tertiary
tokens.usage: The ink for `md-tertiary`, kept so the palette is complete. No rule in the carried sheet reads it.

tokens.name: md-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: `.avatar` and tertiary list leading icons.

tokens.name: md-on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: The glyph on an `md-tertiary-container` fill — `.avatar`, tertiary list leading icons.

tokens.name: md-error
tokens.usage: `.dot.down`, the navbar badge fill, and the errored `.tf-outlined` border and label.

tokens.name: md-on-error
tokens.usage: The count on the navbar badge, over `md-error`.

tokens.name: md-error-container
tokens.usage: `.btn-error`, `.snackbar.error`, `.status-pill.down`, and error list leading icons.

tokens.name: md-on-error-container
tokens.usage: The label on an `md-error-container` fill.

tokens.name: md-surface
tokens.usage: The app ground: `html`/`body`, `.app`, `.m3-topbar`, `.card-outlined`, and the floating `.tf-outlined .lbl`. Carries `md-on-surface`.

tokens.name: md-surface-cont-lowest
tokens.usage: The lowest Material container step, kept so the tonal ramp is complete. No rule in the carried sheet reads it.

tokens.name: md-surface-cont-low
tokens.usage: `.card-elevated`, `.sheet`, `.asset-card`, `.asset-hero`, and the topology bar controls.

tokens.name: md-surface-cont
tokens.usage: `.m3-navbar`, `.search-hint-chip`, `.asset-card:hover`, and the topology search results.

tokens.name: md-surface-cont-high
tokens.usage: `.m3-searchbar` and the pull-to-refresh circle.

tokens.name: md-surface-cont-highest
tokens.usage: `.card-filled`, list leading icons, `.empty-state .icon`, `.status-pill.unk`, `.search-hint-key`.

tokens.name: md-on-surface
tokens.usage: Body copy and headlines on `md-surface` and every `md-surface-cont-*` step.

tokens.name: md-on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Supporting text, icon buttons, chips, placeholders and inactive navbar labels, on the same grounds as `md-on-surface`.

tokens.name: md-outline
tokens.usage: The 1px control edge — `.chip`, `.tf-outlined .field`, `.btn-outlined`, the `.seg` dividers — and `.dot.unk`.

tokens.name: md-outline-variant
tokens.usage: The fainter separator — `.list-divider`, `.card-outlined`, `.kv-row`, `.asset-sect-header`, the spinner track.

tokens.name: md-inverse-surface
tokens.usage: The `.snackbar` ground.

tokens.name: md-inverse-on-surface
tokens.usage: `.snackbar` text, on `md-inverse-surface`.

tokens.name: md-success
tokens.usage: `.dot.up`, `.status-pill.up`, printer glyphs, and success list leading icons.

tokens.name: md-warning
tokens.usage: `.dot.warn`, `.status-pill.warn`, and warning list leading icons.

tokens.name: user-pin-stroke
tokens.usage: The stroke of the user-location pin on the site map (`.user-pin .stroke`). An SVG ink rather than a fill — it must read on the basemap in both palettes.

tokens.name: md-sev-critical
tokens.usage: Critical severity: the alert flag on an asset row and critical alert pills. The dark palette takes md-error; daylight pins a deeper red.

tokens.name: md-sev-serious
tokens.usage: Serious severity, the orange step between warning and critical, on alert pills.

tokens.name: md-sev-warning
tokens.usage: Warning severity on alert pills. The dark palette takes md-warning; daylight pins a darker gold so the word stays readable.

tokens.name: md-sev-notice
tokens.usage: Notice severity, the neutral slate step, on alert pills.

tokens.name: md-sev-info
tokens.usage: Informational severity on alert pills. The dark palette takes md-primary; daylight pins a distinct blue.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: The largest step of the ramp; nothing in the sheet uses it at this size yet. Mirrors the sheet's `.ty-display-s` class: in markup use the class, not this style.

styles.name: headline-s
styles.usage: Screen-level headings; `.asset-hero .hero-name` is set at the same size. Mirrors the sheet's `.ty-headline-s` class: in markup use the class, not this style.

styles.name: title-l
styles.usage: The `.m3-topbar .title` and `.sheet-title` are set at these values. Mirrors the sheet's `.ty-title-l` class: in markup use the class, not this style.

styles.name: title-m
styles.usage: List headlines (`.list-item .headline`), asset names and `.asset-sect-header .sect-title`. Mirrors the sheet's `.ty-title-m` class: in markup use the class, not this style.

styles.name: title-s
styles.usage: Small titles inside cards. Mirrors the sheet's `.ty-title-s` class: in markup use the class, not this style.

styles.name: body-l
styles.usage: Long-form body copy; the `.m3-searchbar .input` and `.tf-outlined .field` are set at this size. Mirrors the sheet's `.ty-body-l` class: in markup use the class, not this style.

styles.name: body-m
styles.usage: Default body copy, `.list-item .supporting` and `.kv-row`. Mirrors the sheet's `.ty-body-m` class: in markup use the class, not this style.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Captions and dense meta text. Mirrors the sheet's `.ty-body-s` class: in markup use the class, not this style.

styles.name: label-l
styles.usage: Button and chip labels (`.btn`, `.chip`, `.fab-ext`). Mirrors the sheet's `.ty-label-l` class: in markup use the class, not this style.

styles.name: label-m
styles.usage: Navigation labels (`.m3-navbar .nav-label`) and small status text. Mirrors the sheet's `.ty-label-m` class: in markup use the class, not this style.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: The fixed height of `.m3-topbar`.

tokens.name: navbar-h
tokens.usage: The height of `.m3-navbar`. Sheets and snackbars anchor at `calc(var(--navbar-h) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))`.

tokens.name: shape-xs
tokens.usage: Corner for `.tf-outlined .field` and `.snackbar`.

tokens.name: shape-sm
tokens.usage: Corner for `.chip`.

tokens.name: shape-md
tokens.usage: Corner for `.card-elevated`, `.card-filled`, `.card-outlined`, `.asset-card`, the login brand logo.

tokens.name: shape-lg
tokens.usage: Corner for `.fab`, `.fab-ext`, the login logo mark.

tokens.name: shape-xl
tokens.usage: Corner for the top two corners of `.sheet`.

tokens.name: shape-full
tokens.usage: The pill corner: `.btn`, `.icon-btn`, `.m3-searchbar`, the active navbar pill, `.status-pill`.

tokens.name: elev-1
tokens.usage: `.card-elevated` and `.m3-searchbar`.

tokens.name: elev-2
tokens.usage: The login screen's logo mark.

tokens.name: elev-3
tokens.usage: `.fab`, `.fab-ext`, `.snackbar`.
